semantics.input: Accumulated fields with value_state/value; effective_m1 is accepted ai/manual output, never raw superseded AI. selectedMedications comes from doctor decision at M3.
semantics.nullPolicy: Numeric comparisons and eq-to-nonnull fail on missing/null; unknown never becomes 0/false.
semantics.evaluation: Groups execute in insertion order per module; within each group ascending priority, first match only. Distinct groups accumulate. Conditions may read output produced by earlier groups.
semantics.effects: set replaces path; append_unique appends if full JSON value absent. Missing groups produce no effect. Output metadata added once.
semantics.recentTests: Test key included only when answered result timestamp <=30 days at fixed visit time AND doctor confirmed reuse; no inference for unknown/time missing/acute override.
semantics.medicationClasses: Sorted union of explicitly structured classes in current medications and doctor-selected new prescription; no string matching on free text.
semantics.diagnosticScope: Demo support for doctors only; no diagnosis, prescription, autonomous medication changes or validated probability.
semantics.outputProjection: After all rule groups: append unresolved/missing gapFields to dataGaps; note null M1 risks; attach M2 recent evidence IDs; copy M3 stage/phenotype from effective_m1; resolve M4 related drug IDs from structured current/selected rows. No new clinical inference.

workflowPolicy.unknownAllowed: All requiredResolved except requiredAnswered; list answered [] means none, unknown list is blocked.
workflowPolicy.invalidation: Any changed field of N marks N and all existing downstream runs stale, revokes effective decisions, preserves history; no automatic runs.
workflowPolicy.manual: Only after attempt>=2; manual_output requires trimmed nonempty manualReason and complete doctor output; forwards decisionSource=manual.
workflowPolicy.m4: Serious alerts require agree/disagree and trimmed nonempty reason for both. Important/monitoring require reason only for disagree. Unresolved serious alerts block complete. Available actions exclude disabled commands; UI may display disabledActions.
